title: The blockwise Alperin weight conjecture

result.label: The blockwise Alperin weight conjecture
result.statement: Proves the numerical blockwise Alperin weight conjecture for every prime and every finite group: the number of irreducible Brauer characters in a block equals the number of conjugacy classes of its weights.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
